recommendation: Keep the audit commit and make no source change for FHIR-5208. Do not add redundant period wording unless a future PA decision changes the cross-organization semantics.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive PA DSTU1 clarification asking whether EpisodeOfCare.period is a single organization's tracking interval rather than a multi-organization shared-care design; the final resolution applies FHIR-5201 and says yes, this is the period for a single organization.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-5208 source commit was found. The likely application is the March 2015 EpisodeOfCare ballot reconciliation trail, especially f659c3fbc16870414aac80f798d75afcb5480bf8, which added the multiple-organization transfer section and status/history period notes.
additional_context: FHIR-5201 is the controlling companion issue named in the FHIR-5208 resolution. Later FHIR-20612 refined the old 'each organization will have its own EpisodeOfCare' wording into the current primary managing organization and optional separate-instance guidance.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the active source already conveys the approved clarification through the managingOrganization and period definitions plus the Scope and Usage transfer-of-care narrative.

related_jiras.note: Controlling companion tracker cited by FHIR-5208's resolution.
Later Published clarification keeps one primary managingOrganization but relaxes the old absolute separate-instance wording.
